signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAEIN( RIGHTV, NOINIT, N, H, LDH, W, V, B, LDB, RWORK,

params.name: rightv
params.reference: = .TRUE. : compute right eigenvector; = .FALSE.: compute left eigenvector.

params.name: noinit
params.reference: = .TRUE. : no initial vector supplied in V = .FALSE.: initial vector supplied in V.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix H. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ldh
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array H. $\mathrm{LDH} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: w
params.reference: The eigenvalue of H whose corresponding right or left eigenvector is to be computed.

params.name: v
params.reference: On entry, if `NOINIT` = .FALSE., V must contain a starting vector for inverse iteration; otherwise V need not be set. On exit, V contains the computed eigenvector, normalized so that the component of largest magnitude has magnitude 1; here the magnitude of a complex number (x,y) is taken to be \|x\| + \|y\|.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: eps3
params.reference: A small machine-dependent value which is used to perturb close eigenvalues, and to replace zero pivots.

params.name: smlnum
params.reference: A machine-dependent value close to the underflow threshold.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `= 1`: inverse iteration did not converge; V is set to the last iterate.
